summary: Added build_writing_state(payload, analysis) and included a JSON-serializable writing_state in every analyze_payload(...) return and in every /api/generate response (blocked / prompt_only / llm / error). Five deterministic states with stable codes + Chinese labels, plus can_generate/can_export/blockers/failures/warnings/required_actions/method=deterministic_writing_state_v1. Approval flags (review_approved/approved) can never override a blocker or fail. Existing keys and status/issues behavior are preserved; no LLM, no DOCX formatting, no review-rule changes.
implemented: backend/server.py: added WRITING_STATE_LABEL map and build_writing_state(payload, analysis) -> {state, label, can_generate, can_export, draft_present, approved, blockers, failures, warnings, required_actions, method}.

State precedence (guarantees approval cannot mask a blocker/fail): blockers -> materials_insufficient (can_generate/export False); elif failures -> needs_revision; elif no draft -> ready_to_draft; elif approved -> ready_to_export (can_export True); else ready_for_review. Note fail issues only arise when a draft is present, so needs_revision implies a draft.
blockers/failures/warnings are derived from analysis issues by issue['level'] (blocker/fail/warning). approved = truthy payload['review_approved'] or payload['approved'] (never inferred).

required_actions is deterministic per state: fill missing fields/facts (insufficient), fix fail issues (needs_revision), generate_draft (ready_to_draft), human_review (ready_for_review), export_docx (ready_to_export).

analyze_payload now builds the analysis dict then attaches analysis['writing_state'] = build_writing_state(payload, analysis) before returning. All prior keys (status, score, issues, missing, genre) are unchanged.

/api/generate: blocked response adds top-level writing_state (also present nested in analysis); non-blocked path sets result['writing_state'] = result['analysis']['writing_state'] after the (re)analysis, so prompt_only/llm/error responses all carry it.

Added tests/test_writing_state.py: all five states, review_approved/approved cannot override blockers or failures, analyze_payload always includes writing_state, JSON-serializable, and an HTTP test that /api/generate blocked response includes writing_state (blocked path does not call the LLM, so no network).
Codex added tests/test_writing_state.py to the py-compile file list in tools/run_quality_gates.py.
